content:
The rw?? tactic is now available in mathlib. It is an interactive library search tactic, that lets the user shift+click on any expression in the tactic state, and it will then give a list of rewrite suggestions for that expression. You can then click on a suggestion to insert the corresponding rw tactic into the editor. Additionally, it uses various heuristics to group, sort and filter the suggestions, so usually the lemma you are looking for is easily to find. It is also significantly faster than rw? which considers all subexpressions.

rwqq.gif

rw?? searches for lemmas using my modified version of lean's discrimination tree, called RefinedDiscrTree. I originally wrote that and the rw?? tactic about 1½ years ago, and 1 year ago I improved the RefinedDiscrTree so that it works efficiently without a pre-built cache. Thanks a lot to @Floris van Doorn for finally getting all of this reviewed and merged.

Discussion is at #mathlib4 > `rw??` discussion .
